title: judgeMaxCostUsd wiring from indexSession to summarize/claims is unasserted
detail: Mutation M8 (drop judgeMaxCostUsd from the extractClaims options in apps/api/src/indexing/session.ts) survives 100% of apps/api session-grounded-wire tests. The cap itself works (checker test: cap 0 through indexSession -> judge never called, nothing written; judge.test/judge-hardening kill the inert-cap mutation), but no committed test pins the session-level pass-through. Also each of summarize and claims builds its own JudgeContext, so KB_NOTE_JUDGE_MAX_USD is per extraction, not per session (up to 2x, plus at most one batch overshoot).
fix_direction: Add an indexSession test with judgeMaxCostUsd:0 asserting the judge is never called; document or share one context if a true per-session cap is intended.
verification_note: Verified by checker verdict f3714036 (lane/w27-judgecost, candidate 4d9c64e9); per-session vs per-extraction cap is an open design note
